entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem planeswalker, creator of Mirrodin and its uncrowned king, sitting fused to his throne with his mind splintered.

entities.name: Half-His-Mind
entities.description: Karn's other voice, which urges him to give the order for war.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metal plane created by Karn, now taking root as New Phyrexia beneath five suns.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexia reborn from oil carried through the aether by Karn, taking root in Mirrodin.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The old Phyrexia, united under Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Megalomaniacal ruler of the old Phyrexia whose will coursed through his minions.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra, cited by Karn in his ramblings.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza, cited by Karn in his ramblings.

entities.name: Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian Chancellor who implores Karn to move on the surface and serves him without question.

entities.name: Norn's subpriest
aliases: subpriest of a Chancellor of Norn
entities.description: Lesser Phyrexian who warns Karn that the Mirrans are organizing.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: Phyrexian Thane who worships Karn's words.

entities.name: Kraynox's archivist
entities.description: Lesser Phyrexian who warns Karn that Jin-Gitaxias does not believe in him.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian who does not believe in Karn and whose spies monitor the throne room.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose fortress hosts a strange materializing being.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Inhabitants of Mirrodin who sense that something is amiss and are organizing.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Region deep under which Jin-Gitaxias's spies monitor the throne room.

entities.name: Great Ideal
entities.description: The Phyrexian ideal that the Mirrans are no threat to.

entities.name: Head attendant
entities.description: Crafty attendant of Karn with a name like shattering glass, who urges protocol.

events.summary: Karn, alone in the silent throne room, wonders who he is while Half-His-Mind says he will become the new Father of Machines.
events.quote: Who am I? Who am I?

events.summary: Karn orders his head attendant to bring everyone in, and the attendants arrange slaughter of one head from each entourage.
events.quote: One head from each entourage will do it.

events.summary: Norn's subpriest and Kraynox's archivist warn Karn about the Mirrans organizing and Jin-Gitaxias's disbelief and spies, urging action.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias does not believe in you,

events.summary: Karn barks the word 'Offense!', which the Phyrexians take as the order to begin the war on the surface.
Karn, left alone, whispers that he has committed the gravest offense, unaware of what he unleashed upon his world.
events.quote: I have committed the gravest offense.

relations.note: New Phyrexia takes root in Mirrodin, his own creation
relations.quote: the abyss of his very own creation: Mirrodin

relations.note: called the Father of Machines and the one meant to lead them
relations.quote: the one who is meant to lead them

relations.note: does not believe in him and plots to replace him
relations.quote: He will spread lies among the praetors to put a false leader in your place.
